primary_changed_factor: the candidate-utility head is retrained with a KD-only PHD2 sample stream: 21,264 rows of official-domain video (PHD2 tier-1, 90s-2h YouTube clips cut into 8-14 s fragments on a 1 s keyframe grid, 30% of them rotated 90 deg clockwise to supply the portrait-source geometry PHD2 otherwise lacks), each labelled by the frozen 32B teacher's point mapped onto the 129-candidate grid as a Gaussian preference. Those rows carry no human crop GT and enter only through a KD term (weight 0.5) alongside the unchanged RetargetVid + rotated-RV + LIVE GT pools. Head architecture, inference path, B0 EMA path, shot resets, all-select mask and YuNet fallback are identical to LFM_V8_B3_SEMIFINAL, so the platform difference is attributable to training data alone. Selection on rv_dev; confirmation by source-level paired bootstrap on live_confirmation (227 sources never used for training or selection) +0.0178 [+0.0076,+0.0282], phd2_val (33 held-out PHD2 sources) +0.0326 [+0.0165,+0.0482], live_dev (124 sources) +0.0142 [+0.0037,+0.0257].

fixed_conditions.temporal: all decoded frames (unchanged) - no temporal head in this package
fixed_conditions.path: B0 EMA alpha .25 on the free axis, B0 thumbnail-diff shot resets, hold within shot; centres from the student head argmax window
fixed_conditions.fallback: B0 observation on head failure / before first keyframe

training.kd_pool: phd2_train (21,264 rows; teacher-point Gaussian targets, no human GT)
training.selection: rv_dev top-1 IoU over steps 500/1000 (best at step 500)

runtime: transformers 5.1, torch_npu 2.10.0, CANN 9.0.0, Ascend 910A; vision tower fp16 eager (no text prompt, no generate), head fp32; attn eager; torch.npu jit_compile=False; 0.05 s/keyframe, 8,848 keyframes over 2 shards in 227 s
prompt: NONE_HEAD (no text prompt at inference; vision-tower tokens only)

components.name: LFM2.5-VL-450M (FP16 inference, all parameters incl. SigLIP2 NaFlex encoder + projector + LFM2 LM)
V9 student candidate-utility head (fp32, 2305-512-128 MLP + 2-layer self-attention, 129 legal windows, PHD2-KD retrained)

declared_size_note: 903,762,857 B of weights = 861.9 MB (2^20) or 903.8 MB (1e6); inside the 500 MB - 9 GB tier so k_size = 0.90, identical to LFM_V8_B3_SEMIFINAL and to the other semifinal packages, which keeps this a clean single-variable test against that package.
notes: Semifinal (426-video) student package. No official score is predicted or claimed. Teacher point set used for the KD stream covers ~45% of the 5,795-fragment pool at training time; a full-data retrain follows when the teacher run finishes.
